title: Conformal-DRO: Distributionally Robust Optimization with Conformalized Ambiguity Set
abstract: arXiv:2609.11073v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Data-driven distributionally robust optimization (DRO) typically treats the conditional outcome law as fixed and uses ambiguity sets to capture estimation error. This paper studies latent distributional heterogeneity, where each instance has an unobserved law but contributes only one observation, so uncertainty persists even if the mixture law is known. We propose Conformal-DRO, which uses nested conformal regions to construct an ambiguity set for the future latent law. Under exchangeability, the set covers this law with probability at least $1-\alpha$ in finite samples, without estimating underlying latent laws or their mixing mechanism. The conformal path induces a data-driven transport geometry, while $\alpha$ determines the radius. The worst-case problem reduces to a finite linear program over conformal shells and admits sparse adversarial solutions. translated_title: Conformal-DRO：基于共形化模糊集的分布鲁棒优化
translated_abstract: 数据驱动的分布鲁棒优化（DRO）通常将条件结果分布视为固定不变的，并使用模糊集来捕捉估计误差。本文研究了潜在分布异质性问题，即每个实例都有一个未被观测到的分布，但仅贡献一个观测值，因此即使混合分布已知，不确定性依然存在。我们提出了Conformal-DRO方法，利用嵌套的共形区域为未来的潜在分布构建模糊集。在可交换性条件下，该集合在有限样本中以至少 $1-\alpha$ 的概率覆盖目标分布，且无需估计潜在的分布或其混合机制。共形路径诱导出一种数据驱动的传输几何结构，而 $\alpha$ 决定了其半径。最坏情况问题可归结为共形壳上的有限线性规划，并允许存在稀疏的对抗解。所得的鲁棒值为所选决策提供了有限样本保证。
tldr: 本文提出Conformal-DRO方法，利用嵌套共形区域构建模糊集以应对潜在分布异质性，在有限样本下提供1-α的分布覆盖保证，并将最坏情况问题转化为具有稀疏对抗解的有限线性规划。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Conformal-DRO, which uses nested conformal regions to construct an ambiguity set for latent distributional heterogeneity, providing finite-sample coverage guarantees of at least 1-α and reducing the worst-case problem to a finite linear program with sparse adversarial solutions.
